decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is a heavily invested flagship that fits the firm's announced direction toward integrated QA, so management stays committed and treats slow uptake as an effect of long proton-center procurement cycles.
Small volume chambers stay core to precision dosimetry and small-field QA, but the earlier withdrawal of a sibling chamber shows the portfolio is being consolidated, so some risk remains.
The multi-model standard clinical chamber line underpins the accredited calibration and dosimetry business and is too central and visible to abandon.
Thimble chambers are staple reference instruments with steady demand and calibration support, so the firm keeps them with little upkeep cost.
